summary: AgilePM® Practitioner with 5 years in a regulated, multi-country payments business (Global Blue, part of Shift4), promoted three times in four years. Delivers change to fixed legal deadlines, including Japan's 2026 VAT reform and France's mandatory e-invoicing, by setting clear scope, managing risk and keeping teams in many countries working to one plan.
cover_letter: I am applying for the Principal Product Manager Agents and Context - Elasticsearch role at Elastic. This role needs a project manager who keeps many teams working to one plan and delivers to fixed deadlines. For 5 years at Global Blue, part of Shift4, a regulated, multi-country payments business, I have done exactly that, and I have been promoted three times in four years.

I prepared 38 international brands, managed from 10 countries, for Japan's 2026 VAT reform, with new contracts agreed before the legal deadline, by setting scope, milestones and dependencies. For France's mandatory e-invoicing I tracked the readiness of 100+ merchants and ran the risk log, and I delivered a 671-store account update inside a fixed system release window.

I run a 25-country governance review cycle with every review held on schedule, produce the monthly business reviews and Town Hall packs for senior leadership, including the Shift4 executive team, and escalate risks to accountable owners with clear decision packs.

I hold the AgilePM® v3 Practitioner certificate and an MA from the University of Sheffield, and I live in Southampton. I would put early effort into learning your tools and ways of working, while bringing delivery discipline from a regulated environment.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the role.
